thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in 429/503s for /v1/generate across multiple regions. Throttled requests = 12.3% last 5m. dom: us-east-1
alex: seeing it too. paging oncall
miranda: on it, checking dashboards
sam: rolling back new routing change? any recent deploys?
ops-bot: deploy: routing-service v2.14 -> completed 5m ago by sam
alex: ok looks coincident with that deploy
miranda: creating live mitigation plan: 1) apply temporary per-tenant soft-rate limit 2) disable non-essential multimodal route 3) increase worker quota for dedicated tenants
leo: product - which tenants impacted? any paying customers seeing errors?
miranda: running quick query now
miranda: PromQL -> sum by(tenant) (rate(api_responses{code=~"4..|5..",path="/v1/generate"}[3m]))
miranda: top offenders: tenant:acme-inc, tenant:chatly, tenant:testing-seed
alex: placing short-term cap on testing-seed first
sam: applying config:
```
POST /admin/config/rate_limit
{
  "tenant": "testing-seed",
  "limit": "200req/min",
  "mode": "soft"
}
```
sam: sent, ops-bot: config apply succeeded
ops-bot: config:rate_limit apply -> ok (testing-seed) by sam
miranda: dashboard panels updated: added "per-tenant 429/503" and "queue depth" to main incident view
miranda: dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/d/incident/429-503-live
alex: still seeing cluster-wide 429s at 5-6% now
sam: disabling multimodal route to cut heavy GPU bursts
sam: command:
```
kubectl -n inference patch service multimodal --type json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/traffic/0/weight","value":0}]'
```
ops-bot: patch applied -> multimodal route weight=0
alex: after disabling multimodal, tail shows error rate dropping gradually
miranda: adding adaptive shedding rule: per-org token bucket with 30% burst allowed
miranda: code snippet for shedder rule
```
{ "shedder": { "strategy": "token_bucket", "burst": 0.3, "window": "60s" }}
```
leo: any customer-facing notes?
alex: ping support to warn top 3 tenants about degraded experience
miranda: support notif draft:
"We are seeing intermittent 429/503 on generation. We have applied temporary rate shaping; you may experience elevated latency or errors. We're working on fit-for-purpose mitigations and will notify when resolved."
leo: ok send to acme and chatly, cc:account
jasmin: i'm on night shift, will take handoff in 30m
alex: quick check: are 503s originating from runtime or gateway?
sam: tracing shows 503s mostly from runtime OOMs and queue overflow
miranda: spun up 4 additional warm workers in east and eu regions
ops-bot: autoscale request -> 4 workers added in us-east-1
alex: monitoring 429s and 503s: prom query
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"4..|5..",job="api-gateway"}[1m])) by (status)
```
miranda: 429 trending down to 1.8% over last 10m, 503s at 0.7%
alex: we're in good shape. plan to keep mitigations for another 45m then roll back gradually
jasmin: i'll watch for escalation when i take over
miranda: schedule: 30m checkpoint -> if stable reduce shedder burst to 15%, re-enable multimodal at 50% weight
sam: note: will hold new routing deploys until incident closed
alex: thanks team. documenting timeline in postmortem channel
miranda: will capture timestamps and dash snapshots
incident-bot: incident-note: mitigation actions applied: per-tenant caps, multimodal disabled, adaptive shedder, +4 workers. incident severity -> P2
alex: handoff to jasmin in 10m. attaching logs and grafana snapshots to thread
jasmin: ack, i'll take it from here and update next 30m
ops-bot: alert: new deploys blocked by incident lock
alex: closing active coordination. follow up: cleanup runbook to remove temp rules in 2 hours if stable :thumbsup:
miranda: copying all actions to /incidents/1802103456-postmortem

leo: will prepare customer comms template for post-incident
